_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Priest tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped. discipline_pd = Discipline/Power-Word family. Forever renames/new vs Cata: Power Word: Shield also as Power Word: Barrier (CD side), Spirit of Redemption active -> Spirit of the Redeemer, Shadow Word: Death, Shadowguard, Hex/Touch of Weakness, Eye of the Void, Void Zone/Shadowfiend/Devouring Plague + Void Plague, Chastise (the Forever smite-strike), Deliverance, Levitate as a priest buff. Circle of Healing, Eye of the Void, Homunculi, Power Word: Barrier and Void Plague also exist as Mage cross-class talent rows; the generator resolves them to Priest rows via its family-scoped rank resolution. T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1 ruling): the reference's CAST spells are added -- cooldowns += Devouring Plague, Prayer of Mending, Mind Blast; buffs += Vampiric Touch, Renew, Holy Fire, Mind Flay, Mind Sear (all eight ride a real window). The reference's proc/passive names (see _deferred_H7) ride with H7 (docs/design-combat-procs.md). Wave I-2b (2026-11-03, upstream-data §5.1): [cooldowns] += Dark Inspiration (1326168, the 10 s talent-rank party-buff window the data carries; 1326159 is the value-less sibling -- upstream-data §3.5).
